column3: “The Nile” identifies the river; “it” replaces the reflexive object myself in the final claim.
“For burial” specifies the purpose of gathering.
“Israel” identifies the subject; wrenched backs replaces causing all the loins to stand.
“You” replaces he; Nile identifies the river.
“Restore Egypt from captivity” renders turning back Egypt’s captivity.
Opening the mouth replaces giving an opening of mouth; “to speak” supplies its purpose.
